messages:
Zara (product): FYI: Tool-calling and structured streaming egress are GA for Hosted API. Release stabilizes function frames, adds audit hooks, and includes per-org safety toggles. Rolling in waves over ~48h. Migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/toolcall-ga

Ben (eng-runtime): Tech highlights: - New endpoint: /v4/streaming-generate (consolidates prior streaming paths). - Per-request opt-in header: X-RW-Tool-Mode: enabled|disabled. - We emit detailed audit events (tool.call.request, tool.call.result) to Console. Backwards compatible for raw token consumers.

Maya (security): Policy update: tool execution is OFF by default for orgs created after 2026-01-01. Existing orgs keep their current setting. Enabling requires an audit-contact email on the org and acceptance of the operator policy in Console -> Security -> Tooling.

Ravi (support): Heads-up: new error code TOOL_BLOCKED (403) when a request attempts tool execution while org is opted-out. Add KB snippet explaining how to toggle and where to find audit logs (Console -> Security -> Tool Audit).

Lena (devex): SDK note: @redwood/sdk-js v4.1.0 and @redwood/sdk-py v4.1.0 add streamTools()/stream_tools() helpers and automatic schema validation. Example (JS):

```js
const stream = client.streamTools({ model: 'rwd-tool-3', input: 'Scan repo', stream: true })
stream.on('event', e => console.log(e))
```

Tom (infra): Rollout plan: canary us-east-1 -> eu-west-1 -> apac. DeployBot started canary at 1791239901. Guardrails: default tool-exec-rate per-org = 10/min (adjustable via Console). Watch P95 stream latency dashboards.

Zara (product): Action items for eng & product teams: 1) Update integrations to include X-RW-Tool-Mode where applicable, 2) Verify org settings and add audit-contact where needed, 3) Update quickstarts to SDK v4.1.0 and patch examples. Reply here with DONE when completed.

DeployBot: rollout:toolcall-ga -> canary:us-east-1 ✅ started at 1791239901, est global completion 1791247101.

Ben (eng-runtime): Troubleshooting tip: if you receive function_call frames with schema_error, confirm org enablement and that the function schema matches the request. If noisy, ping #eng-runtime for expanded logs.

Zara (product): We'll post a customer blog and targeted emails to enterprise accounts after we validate metrics. Thanks all — please monitor support queues for the next 72h.
